scope: Active bilingual curriculum, calendar, project specifications, procurement, reading catalogue and integrity of preserved source documents.

engineering_findings_fixed.issue: Stale June 2028 completion contradicted the December 2027 calendar.
engineering_findings_fixed.verification: Official Gazebo page lists Harmonic EOL May 2029; no lifecycle change required.

engineering_findings_fixed.issue: M4/UTM and a required ARM64 environment were asserted despite unspecified MacBook Pro CPU/model.
engineering_findings_fixed.correction: Establish actual Mac architecture in M01 and qualify selected Ubuntu/VM configuration.
engineering_findings_fixed.verification: Official Gazebo platforms: Jammy/Noble amd64; ARM remains best-effort. Hardware architecture itself remains unknown.

engineering_findings_fixed.issue: Same-recording evaluation merged offline estimation with closed-loop controller evaluation.
engineering_findings_fixed.correction: Filters use identical sensor recordings; PID/LQR use separate closed-loop runs with matched initial conditions, limits and disturbances.
engineering_findings_fixed.verification: LQR is state feedback; changed control alters future plant state.

engineering_findings_fixed.issue: Russian OMY-F3M copy labelled ±0.05 mm as accuracy, although official spec is repeatability.
engineering_findings_fixed.verification: Official source gives 580 mm reach, 3 kg payload and ±0.05 mm repeatability. Estimate Russian already correct; English estimate updated too.

engineering_findings_fixed.issue: Validated baseline heading implied an achieved result although all hardware remains unbuilt.
Command monotonic timestamp and expiry lacked clock-domain mapping/session semantics.
engineering_findings_fixed.correction: Sender clock domain plus bounded host/MCU mapping, receiver-local watchdog, session reset and rejection of unverified freshness.
engineering_findings_fixed.verification: Applied existing cross-clock requirements consistently to tail; no protocol implementation claimed.

engineering_findings_fixed.issue: Safe neutral after tendon failure was not guaranteed by the proposed mechanism.
engineering_findings_fixed.correction: Guarded stop and mechanically bounded sag; supported unworn-rig test of shape/elastic energy, no guaranteed neutral return.
engineering_findings_fixed.verification: Engineering consistency correction; no destructive or human test performed.

engineering_specs_rechecked.result: Confirmed 12 V, 100 rpm, 6533 output counts, 5 V encoder supply suitable with level shifting; 34 kg cm/5.5 A extrapolated stall and 10 kg cm continuous gearbox recommendation correctly distinguished from tested duty.
18 ST motors staged 1+2+9+6; tail six motors/three dual drivers/six current sensors with reuse explicitly counted. 29 A PSU versus 48.6 A aggregate stall caveat already explicit.
400 mm/500 g framed as targets, distal loads and duty included; actuator alternatives gated on prototype qualification. No achievable-payload promise inferred from stall torque.

source_findings_fixed.issue: M05 assigned FEM reading while the core defers FEA.
source_findings_fixed.fix: Core reading now specifies hand beam stress/deflection calculations and measurement; FEM chapter/module 18 explicitly optional further development.

source_findings_fixed.issue: Page claimed all revision 3 work packages but omitted historical G1-G4, 20 hours each.
source_findings_fixed.fix: Added four gates (80 h), making work tables sum to 3855 h; added separately labelled historical reserve 300 h and final-week padding 45 h, total capacity 4200 h.

source_findings_fixed.issue: RU edition field rendered the English prose despite Russian metadata being present.

calendar_checks.scope: Static schedule/content accounting, including five M09 execution-segment prerequisite edges; planned gates and supplier receipt are not completed results.

calendar_findings_fixed: Removed FEA from the core M05 outcome and made FEM reading optional.
Clarified that L1 fabrication is allocated once, without duplicate hours in later modules.
Made gates and material receipt explicit conditions of active-work target dates; shipping, unattended printing and cooling have no separate elapsed-time allowance.
Explained the 50 h/week availability assumption, absence of holiday allowance and limits of the 85 h spare capacity.
procurement_findings_fixed: Removed obsolete AS5600 price and previous-seller minimum-order calculation.
Corrected resistor-assortment stock status; explicitly listed missing 4.7/6.8/10 kΩ 1% parts and order minima.
Moved crimp tools to M07, clamped work support to M05, flexible foot material to L1 and motor spool hubs to T2.
Added a priced drill/driver kit with two batteries and charger.
Added the C14 inlet needed by the C13 mains cord, plus insulated wire terminals.
Aligned card quantities with sold packs, prototype scope and conditional nozzle purchases.
Clarified stage-dependent material reuse without implying exactly one physical part.
Replaced references to absent research files with maintained repository reports.
Corrected tail hub expansion to T2 and used ordinary unit prices for staged purchases, excluding an inapplicable three-pack single-order discount.
limitations: Static plan and source audit; no physical prototype, electrical qualification, payload, thermal or wearable test has been performed.
MacBook processor/model and Creality printer model remain unspecified; compatible environment and nozzles require actual-device checks.
Prices and availability are dated seller observations. Card subtotals exclude shipping, order-minimum shortfalls, import costs, fabrication labour and further parts required by the final CAD.
Some product pages restrict automated access; details are preserved in procurement-link-verification.json. Foreign shipping to the exact Ukraine destination is not confirmed for every offer.
Archived PDF integrity and extraction structure were checked; not every historical external link was fetched and not every PDF page was visually inspected.
Calendar dates depend on available weekly hours, passed gates and received parts; they are not guaranteed supplier or project completion dates.
Language navigation was tested in the mocked DOM and HTML parsed statically; no real-browser visual pass is claimed.
